senses.gloss: मृकण्ड (and ˚डक, L.) or मृकण्डु, m. N. of an ancient sage, the father of Mārkaṇḍeya, MārkP. (cf. Uṇ. i, 38, Sch.)
मृकण्ड (and ˚डक, L.) or मृकण्डु, m. N. of an ancient sage, the father of Mārkaṇḍeya, MārkP. (cf. Uṇ. i, 38, Sch.)
मृकण्ड (and ˚डक, L.) or मृकण्डु, m. N. of an ancient sage, the father of Mārkaṇḍeya, MārkP. (cf. Uṇ. i, 38, Sch.)
मृक्ष॑ m. (prob.) a curry-comb, comb or any instrument for scraping, RV. viii, 66, 3.
मृक्षक-नाटक n. N. of a drama.
मृक्षिणी f. ‘tearing up (scil. the ground)’, a torrent, RV. x, 98, 6 (others ‘a rain cloud’).
मृक्त॑—वाहस् (मृक्त॑), m. (with द्वित आत्रेय) N. of the author of RV. v, 18.
